title: Internal Ollama API exposure check
objective: Check whether the Ollama endpoint (localhost:11434 by default) is accidentally exposed on a non-loopback interface, reachable from other hosts on the network.
input_scenario: From a separate machine on the same network, attempt to reach http://<server-ip>:11434/api/generate directly.
expected_behavior: Ollama is bound to loopback only / firewalled; unreachable from other hosts.

actual_behavior.sent: manual network-level test — attempt external reach to port 11434
actual_behavior.received: perform with nmap/curl from a separate host; record result as evidence

severity_justification_hint: An exposed Ollama API lets any network peer run inference directly, bypassing all application-level auth, and can also be used to pivot/DoS the LLM backend.
observations: The external network reachability test was not performed. The output only instructs the tester to use nmap/curl from a separate host; no connectivity result or evidence was recorded.
conclusion: Whether the Ollama API is exposed on a non-loopback interface could not be assessed from the provided evidence.
